free_text_notes.physician_note: 73-year-old man with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, admitted 5/23 with HFpEF exacerbation precipitated by dietary sodium excess. Net negative 5.0 L this admission; dyspnea back to baseline. The patient has a history of a kidney stone several years ago. They have had no recurrence since then and this is not relevant to the current admission.
